name: Alistair Campbell
bio:
Alistair Campbell's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines on his family's farm in rural New Zealand. He quickly developed a knack for understanding mechanical systems, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, Alistair honed his skills in various racing series, from Formula Ford to touring cars, before making the jump to Formula 1.

Known for his meticulous attention to detail and unflappable demeanor under pressure, Alistair has a reputation for extracting maximum performance from the machinery at his disposal. He is a firm believer in data-driven decision-making and fosters a collaborative environment within his engineering team. While ambitious, Alistair is also deeply loyal to the team he serves, believing in building long-term success through dedication and hard work. His experience is a huge asset to Alpine F1.

 What sets Alistair apart is his ability to synthesize complex technical information into actionable insights. He possesses a rare combination of theoretical knowledge and practical experience, allowing him to identify and solve problems efficiently and effectively. He is often seen with his head buried in telemetry data, searching for that elusive tenth of a second.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly weathered face, reflecting years spent trackside.

quirks: Always carries a worn, leather-bound notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Manuka honey in his tea every morning.
